title: BALTO: Balanced Token-Level Policy Optimization for Hallucination Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2606.15893v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Hallucinations remain a major obstacle to deploying large language models (LLMs) in knowledge-intensive settings, where generated responses must be faithfully grounded in provided evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising direction for hallucination mitigation, but response-level faithfulness rewards suffer from a granularity mismatch: localized hallucinations can cause supported content to receive spurious penalties. Although recent work introduces fine-grained feedback such as claim-level verification and token-level rewards, unbalanced credit assignment can still induce length, verbosity, or optimization-noise biases. We propose BALTO, a Balanced Token-level Policy Optimization framework for hallucination mitigation. BALTO extracts checkable factual claims, verifies them against the reference context, and projects claim-level judgments to token-level labels. translated_title: BALTO：用于缓解幻觉的平衡词元级策略优化
translated_abstract: 幻觉仍然是大型语言模型（LLM）在知识密集型场景中部署的主要障碍，在这些场景中，生成的回答必须忠实地基于所提供的证据。强化学习（RL）是缓解幻觉的一个有前景的方向，但回答级别的忠实度奖励存在粒度不匹配的问题：局部化的幻觉可能导致本已获得支持的内容受到虚假惩罚。尽管近期的工作引入了细粒度的反馈，例如声明级别的验证和词元级别的奖励，但不平衡的信用分配仍然可能引发长度、冗长或优化噪声方面的偏差。我们提出了BALTO，一个用于缓解幻觉的平衡词元级策略优化框架。BALTO提取可核查的事实性声明，将其与参考上下文进行验证，并将声明级别的判断投影到词元级别的标签上。该框架引入了一种平衡的词元级信用分配机制。
tldr: 提出了BALTO框架，通过提取可验证的事实性声明并将其判断投影为词元级标签，结合平衡的词元级信用分配机制，解决了现有强化学习方法中的粒度不匹配与偏差问题，从而有效缓解大语言模型的幻觉。
